tips.text: Crack the relics you already own in short Capture or Exterminate fissures; they are the fastest source of the 500 Ducats.
Keep 500 Ducats and 220,000 credits banked at all times; 48 hours is too short to start farming once Baro lands.
Buy it on the first visit that has it; gaps between appearances have run eight or nine months.
Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat reward.
Skip Aya for Ducats at Varzia; everyone who mentioned 5 Ducats per Aya called it terrible.
Players call it fine but redundant, so buy it for the look or the Mastery.
Nobody complains about the cost; the only complaint is waiting for Baro to bring it back.
